conversation_history.message: We get all business from word of mouth

Word of mouth is undeniably the best source! But even word-of-mouth referrals look up your website or Instagram at 9 PM on their phones. If they hit a static page with no date checker, 60% delay contacting and often end up booking another venue with instant answers.

Take a look at the live date-checker prototype: https://calendly.com/agency-demo/15min
We already have enough customers and we pay 25% on Zomato/Swiggy happily.

Every luxury wedding or corporate gala is unique! That's why the bot doesn't make the final booking—it qualifies the 3 core criteria (Date, Guest Count, Budget Tier) and immediately books a 15-minute consultation with your lead planner.

Quick 5-min walkthrough: https://calendly.com/agency-demo/15min
